findings: The skill-to-PQ reverse projection previously skipped malformed entries while computing edge counts; it now requires object entries and list-valued skill_ids.
Reverse projection PQ identities, skill IDs, duplicate edges, and references to unknown canonical skill IDs are now rejected explicitly.
The canonical PQ forward relationship validator now checks PQ identity, non-empty target and source strings, recognized relationship type, and duplicate (pq, relationship, target) keys.
PQ current_counts values are required to be non-negative integers and booleans are rejected.
source_of_truth_policy: Canonical docs/data/skills.json and docs/data/pq-reward-relationships.json remain authoritative. Indexes, verified layers, reverse projections, and historical recovery snapshots must not be used to reconstruct surviving canonical records.
validation_boundary: Changes were committed through the GitHub API. Runtime execution and CI results were not available in this environment and remain unverified.
